items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: although he certainly wouldn't have been considered as jazz oriented as somebody like Johnny Hodges or Hilton Jefferson or Happy Haddie Caldwell, anybody like that.

ctx.x: I don't think he ever did. He was a fantastic technician; absolutely fantastic, believe me. And he was much more jazz oriented than you know, than Rudy Wiedoeft, although he certainly wouldn't have been considered as jazz oriented as somebody like Johnny Hodges or Hilton Jefferson or Happy Haddie Caldwell, anybody like that.
What about a Boyd Centa? I mean he made a great number of records.

items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Benny was playing C-melody, and I was playing alto, and Benny gave me his job, and Walter was on drum.

ctx.x: Well, now where did you meet him?
Walter was working at the dance school when I left Mamie. Dornell and them (Unintelligible) -- Benny was playing C-melody, and I was playing alto, and Benny gave me his job, and Walter was on drum.
